Soy ingeniero de caminos y me dedico a <: I am a civil engineer, and my work is putting information in order with code and artificial intelligence. I come from the projects where you learn that the hard way: three years leading models, data and automation on major international works, where the order of the information sets the deadlines and the costs.
Hoy tengo dos frentes que se alimentan e: Today I work on two fronts that feed each other. I build ontos, the system that puts my own life in order, and I bring the same method to people and companies, from their context for AI to a website or a world in 3D.
Los tres años anteriores a ontos los pas: I spent the three years before ontos on projects where the volume of information is beyond any one person, and the only way out is to build systems that put it in order on their own.
<strong class=\"cargo\">BIM Manager</str: BIM Manager for the package of 41 cross passages. I automated their modelling and the loading of metadata to the client's requirements: what I first had to solve by hand ended up being solved by code.
<strong class=\"cargo\">BIM Coordinator<: BIM Coordinator at the Sydney Water treatment plant (Malabar Water Resource Recovery Facility).
<strong class=\"cargo\">BIM Manager</str: BIM Manager for the desalination plant of the Northern Water Supply Project (140 ML/day). I managed the delivery of 67 models with a workflow I fully automated, supported by AI: the time saved on checks, exports and audits is worth the work of up to five people.

Plan de desarrollo urbano de las goberna: Urban development plan for the Red Sea governorates, with GIS training for the team in Riyadh.
GIS y plan de ejecución BIM de los túnel: GIS and BIM execution plan for the tunnels of The Line.
Premio de innovación (I+D) de TYPSA, 202: Innovation Award (R&D), TYPSA, 2024, and a paper at the 19th Australasian Tunnelling Conference (ATC 2025) for automating the parametric modelling of tunnel cross passages.
